story.title: The Cloud That Walked Like a Man

sentences.text: Never speak the old name after midnight in County Cork.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.text: An asteroid fell near the pasture, bringing an ash-colored swarm with golden eyes.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.text: The old tales say the creature grows louder every time its forbidden name is whispered.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.text: My grandson pulled my coat and pointed at the dark glass window.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.text: Grandpa, there is a man made of buzzing dust outside.
sentences.speaker: person

sentences.text: It moved in rigid jerks, like an old film with missing frames.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.text: The latch gave way, and the hollow face leaned inside.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.text: Only a scattered heap of ash remained upon the floorboards.
sentences.speaker: narrator
